Class 2 acquirer exception applies. Correct generic no-news/ETP description; concurrent acquisition financing does not itself replace documented deal attribution.

September 10 issuer IBM acquisition release also gives preliminary revenue for Q3 already ended August 31, subject to quarterly close. Earnings preannouncement exclusion takes precedence over otherwise eligible acquisition/partnership catalyst. Preserve concurrent IBM deal; do not assert earnings alone caused the jump.

Primary TE acquisition agreement is signed January 27 but issuer announcement is dated January 28. Targeted date/deal search did not recover January 27 public rumor timing or direct jump attribution. Substantively class 2 acquirer candidate; contract execution date alone cannot explain preceding-session gain.

December 10 primary Royall acquisition release schedules 6 p.m. ET call; December 11 analyst upgrade explicitly follows prior-night acquisition. Class 2 acquirer candidate is documented. Direct session price attribution and distinction between transaction and analyst amplification remain unverified; leave pending rather than generic no-news.
